rounds.text: Josts Engineering Company Ltd presents a concerning disconnect between its reported profitability and actual cash generation. While the company reports profit, it suffered a negative operating cash flow of Rs -10 Cr in Mar 2026, resulting in a poor cash conversion ratio of -0.32x [E29, E30]. This cash burn is further evidenced by a negative free cash flow of Rs -13 Cr [E31]. The quality of earnings is also highly questionable, as the reported figures include a significant other income component of Rs 36.2 Cr [E49]. Compounded profit growth over the trailing twelve months has plummeted by 59% [E17], and the return on equity has turned negative at -8.0% [E13, E24]. Furthermore, operational efficiency is deteriorating, with working capital days increasing from 58.6 to 86.6 days [E51]. Conceded: the company maintains a strong liquidity position with a current ratio of 3.72x and has successfully reduced its debt [E33, E34, E35].
